newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner merges its water operations.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner merges its water operations.

text.p: Engineering group Kvaerner Plc said it will merge its water related technology businesses in Britain, Norway and Sweden into a single unit, with combined 1996 turnover of more than 50 million stg.
The new unit will be called Kvaerner Water and will be chaired by Keith Clarke, Kvaerner's executive vice president.
The new unit is expected to grow significantly in turnover as it is spreading its wings across the globe, Kvaerner said.
"This a further step in the integration of the Kvaerner and Trafalgar House businesses which we acquired last April," said Kvaerner's president and chief executive Erik Tonseth.
"In creating Kvaerner Water, we are demonstrating our determination to exploit worldwide, our professional strength and environmental expertise in this sector," Tonseth added.
Kvaerner Water will continue to have its operating and technology centres in Scandinavia and Stockton-on-Tees in north east England.
